Check if a Taxon is Local to a Country

Source: R/inat.R
is_taxon_local.Rd

Check if a Taxon is Local to a Country

Usage

is_taxon_local(taxon, country, n_min = 2)

Arguments

taxon

character giving the scientific name of the taxon.

country

character giving the name of the country that is considered to be local.

n_min

the minimal number of observations that must be found for the taxon to be accepted as local.

Value

a logical value indicating whether the taxon is local to the given country or not. If the function encounters any issues, it returns NA.

Details

Only research grade observations are taken into account to reduce the chance that misidentified observations skew the result.
